summary.description: A concise Markdown overview of the minimalism review.

findings.description: Unnecessary structure worth flagging as an inline comment.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root, exactly as it appears in the diff.

line.description: Line number in the NEW version of the file. Must be a line that appears in the PR diff.

body.description: A self-contained comment identifying what to remove, the smaller implementation, and proof that acceptance conditions remain satisfied.
